summary: Harden autonomy outcome tests and bounded live repair diagnostics

delivery.outcome: Publish reliable separated test runners and bounded live repair measurements; diagnose actual generated-code failures and preserve outcomes.

architecture.decision: Select explicit local suites; inject deterministic failure fixtures; instrument live model responses, parser diagnostics, bounded repair, complete token accounting and independently verified offline Docker outcomes.
architecture.rollback: Remove disposable test containers; retain prior main and source packages unchanged.

validation.evidence: Negative outcome and repair-budget regression tests, isolated container tests, bounded live probe artifacts.
